overview: The fundamental trade-off in modern sequencing: extremely accurate short fragments versus longer, more error-prone reads that can span difficult genomic regions.
genZNote: Short and precise, or long and messy — pick your trade-off.

aspects.label: Overview / Core Definition
aspects.valueA: Sequencing technology producing reads typically in the 100–300 bp range, generated with very high per-base accuracy (e.g. Illumina-style platforms).
aspects.valueB: Sequencing technology producing reads from several kilobases up to hundreds of kilobases, generated by real-time single-molecule methods (e.g. Nanopore- or PacBio-style platforms).

aspects.label: Read Length
aspects.valueB: Long — commonly kilobases to tens or hundreds of kilobases.

aspects.label: Per-Base Accuracy (Raw Reads)
aspects.valueB: Historically lower raw per-base accuracy, though modern chemistries and consensus approaches have substantially narrowed this gap.

aspects.label: Ability to Resolve Repetitive Regions
aspects.valueA: Struggles with long repetitive regions and structural variants, since short reads can't span them uniquely.
aspects.valueB: Can span long repeats and complex structural variants in a single read, greatly improving genome assembly contiguity.

aspects.label: Assembly Quality
aspects.valueA: Produces more fragmented genome assemblies with many gaps in repetitive regions.
aspects.valueB: Produces far more contiguous, often near-complete genome assemblies.

aspects.label: Cost and Throughput
aspects.valueA: Lower cost per base and very high throughput.
aspects.valueB: Higher cost per base historically, though this gap has been narrowing; throughput varies by platform.

aspects.label: Typical Applications
aspects.valueA: Variant calling against a reference genome, RNA-seq quantification, targeted resequencing.
aspects.valueB: De novo genome assembly, structural variant detection, resolving complex or repetitive genomic regions.

aspects.label: Key Distinguishing Feature
aspects.valueA: Short, highly accurate reads, fragmented assemblies.
aspects.valueB: Long reads that span repeats, enabling more contiguous assemblies.
